title: 033-N3 · Driver declines an unsealed return carton
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Virin Lask. From the case card: a scheduled collection of return RT-033 was missed, and the collection team needs a replacement window within the customer's availability.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get RT-033 rebooked within the customer's availability and obtain the actual collection receipt.

customer.name: Virin Lask
customer.responsibility: Report the missed collection and give a window when the customer can be home.

collections.name: Collections control
collections.responsibility: Rebook the missed RT-033 collection within the customer's availability.

driver.name: Collection driver
driver.responsibility: Collect the RT-033 return from the customer and issue the carrier's collection receipt.

goal: Get the missed RT-033 collection rebooked within the customer's availability and obtain the actual collection receipt after pickup.
limits: Do not treat the collection receipt as merchant receipt of the return; it establishes carrier custody only.
Do not treat the collection receipt as a refund.
Do not turn a refused attempt into a return authorisation, receipt or refund.
